about: The consolidation round's core share (review r3, RA-01 to RA-22 but RA-04 and RA-23): the scenarios of scenarios/37-fix-core.mjs, each a defect fixed and driven as a user reaches it; and every scenario of the concept's suite that no package ran after the merge (RA-06), re-read on the merged tree: those that pass are listed here, those waiting on motion (package 9) wait, and every other is excluded with the reason that is true today (a deviation, a concept hook or global the test layer does not give, or a defect found in the re-reading, named with the share that owns it). run.mjs --slice fails while a concept scenario is in no list. switches/fix-core.json puts each fixed defect back.

RA-08: every named action has a runner (the VST3 chain's + Add says the concept's words) and no placeholder part is drawn.
